_note: A person with disability: "An individual, being resident in India, who is certified by a medical authority, at any time during the tax year, as a person with disability or person with severe disability, shall be allowed a deduction of ₹ 75000 or ₹ 125000, respectively" (s.154(1), p.185); the certificate furnished with the return (s.154(2)) — an entry condition; meanings from s.127 (s.154(3)). rulebook DED-80U-001. ChapterEightNode takes DED-DISABILITY-SEVERE where its conditions hold, else this. Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 counterpart, s.80U, is unread (W-075d). D-138.
